rationale.consistency: License headers, interface guards, module registration, humanize sizes and nolint comments match siblings; but handler JSON uses time.Duration instead of caddy.Duration, time.ParseDuration instead of caddy.ParseDuration, and no UnmarshalCaddyfile method.
rationale.edge_cases: Nil body and chunk-loop termination handled, but HardDeadline is never populated from ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout so the idle reset can push past the hard cap; MinRate without Timeout yields an already-expired deadline; per-route write_max_chunk alone clears the server write deadline.
rationale.scope: Focused on the requested files and options; only stray item is the HardDeadline field that production code never wires.
rationale.readability: Clear names, small shared IdleDeadline.next, good doc comments; the IdleDeadline type comment is muddled.
rationale.robustness: Deadline is only reset after successful writes/reads, so any handler gap over the 1m default (SSE, slow upstream streaming) fails its next write; unsupported controllers log a warning on every read/write; zero deadline silently clears Go's hard timeout.
rationale.maintainability: Deadline math is centralized and reused by server and handler, but the two wrapping blocks are duplicated verbatim and the unused HardDeadline field invites confusion.
